## Description

Runbook for verifying licences: which public register per authority, evidence captured (screenshot/reference), SLA (usually within 1 working day), rejection reasons, re-verification on expiry, and who may perform it (ops vs owner attestation).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Runbook published in docs/runbooks/licence-verification.md and linked from F-09.
- [ ] **AC2.** Every pilot doctor's licence is verified with recorded evidence before they sign real notes.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
